# @moshaar/env

> 标签: ci, devops, env, moshaar, openbao, secrets, vault

## 简介

Fetch secrets from OpenBao and inject into a spawned command. No .env files needed. For Moshaar platform devs.

- 官网：https://gitlab.mushar.co/moshaar/devops-moshaar
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@moshaar/env
